company.name: Walter
company.shortDescription: Walter is a Montreal-based company that developed an app to help connect property managers and residents of condominium.
company.description:
Smart building technology for your community.

Stay in contact with your property manager, send work orders in real-time, receive important notifications about your building, order on-demand curated concierge services, and manage your tenants all in one place.

Developers and property managers who use Walter can provide a superior and simpler living experience to their residents. Our very goal is to do so by offering smart building technology.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based SaaS platform that centralizes communication, task management, and building operations for property managers and residents in multi-residential and commercial buildings.
productsAndServices.name: Usewalter Property Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: An in-app service that connects residents with local service providers for booking and paying for in-home services such as housekeeping, personal training, and dog walking.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Concierge Service

productsAndServices.description: A system that automatically notifies residents when packages arrive at the building's front desk, improving package tracking and delivery communication.
productsAndServices.name: Smart Package Management System

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows Usewalter to connect with external accounting software and IoT devices to synchronize building data and smart device controls in one platform.
productsAndServices.name: Integration with Third-Party Property Management and IoT Software

productsAndServices.description: Features including live chat, news announcements, classifieds, and a monthly calendar to facilitate communication and community building between residents and property managers.
productsAndServices.name: Resident Communication and Engagement Tools
